WITH per_gender AS (
    SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count
    FROM Invoices AS i
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.gender
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) AS overall_average
    FROM per_gender
)
SELECT AVG(pg.invoiced_order_count) AS average_invoiced_order_count,
       AVG(pg.invoiced_order_count - overall.overall_average) AS average_excess_over_overall
FROM per_gender AS pg
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE pg.invoiced_order_count > overall.overall_average;
